text:
maya: Heads-up: need an onboarding + migration plan for FalconX-v2 next quarter. Primary ask: let Dedicated/private customers opt into a compatibility adapter before we deprecate v1.
arthur: What's the proposed grace window?
lina: Thinking 45d opt-in + 90d full deprecation, with per-customer extend option. Need canaries + rollback gates.
kevin: Could build a runtime 'compat adapter' that maps v1 calls to v2 and shims response schema. Adds infra cost but reduces customer change work.
maya: Adapter + per-customer toggle + logs + auto-fallback to v1 for high-error routes. Need SLA and cost impact doc.
sam: CS signals: Customers A/B want longer runway. Note: Customer A is on-prem — migration involves packaging + KMS rekey.
arthur: Operational gates: telemetry for top N prompt buckets, early-warning alerts in #incidents, and auto rollback after 2 failing canaries.
catalog-bot: New catalog entry created: model_id=rx-fx-v2, pinned_compat=false, tags=[gen,fast]
lina: Draft launch criteria: onboarding doc, migration playbook, customer evals passing, rollout automation, cost delta, rollback runbook.
kevin: Quick perf note: adapter estimated +15% GPU-hours at p99 for seq 512. I'll add numbers to infra sheet.
maya: Proposal: accept 45/90 default with per-customer extension up to 180d. Vote: +1 to build adapter prototype.
sam: :thumbsup: +1 from CS — we'll prepare top-10 outreach comms.
arthur: I'll schedule canary next Wed. Owners: @lina (quality), @kevin (infra), @maya (product).
lina: I'll author the migration playbook. Draft ETA EOD Fri.
kevin: config example:
```json
{
  "adapter": "v1-to-v2",
  "shim_rules": ["map_meta_field","truncate_stop_tokens"],
  "fallback": "v1"
}
```
maya: I'll open a GH issue and tag owners. Note: do not change global pin defaults without exec signoff.
catalog-bot: Pin change proposed: add per-customer flag 'extend_window'. Submitted for review.
